findings.comment: Required zoning district setback lines for MF-2 are not shown, labeled, or clearly dimensioned on the site plan. While a few dimension lines appear to show distances to property lines, they are not identified as required front, rear, interior side, or street side setback lines per LDC § 25-2-492.

applicableAreas: site boundaries and southern property line adjacent to SF-3 parcel
findings.comment: Article 10 compatibility standards applicability was incorrectly determined as 'No' in the site plan application. The site is zoned MF-2 (less restrictive than MF-4) and is located within 75 feet of a triggering property—the adjacent SF-3 zoned parcel (William James Estate, Parcel 0406100210). SF-3 qualifies as a triggering property zone per § 25-2-1053. Article 10 applies to this project and compliance documentation must be provided.

applicableAreas: southern property line shared with SF-3 triggering property
findings.comment: Compatibility buffer not shown at the required width along the southern property line shared with the SF-3 triggering property. A 25-foot landscaped buffer is required per § 25-2-1062(B). Building 6 is positioned at 24.8 feet from the property line, encroaching into the required buffer zone. The buffer line must be drawn, labeled, and dimensioned on both the site plan and landscape plan sheets.

Triggering property (SF-3 zoned parcel to the south) is not clearly identified or labeled on the site plan. Adjacent property zoning and dwelling unit count must be labeled to confirm that the property qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053 and to demonstrate compliance with Article 10 requirements.

applicableAreas: site boundaries, adjacent property boundaries, building locations
findings.comment: Separate compatibility exhibit sheet is not provided. Required documentation must show property boundaries, on-site and off-site zoning boundaries (including triggering property location and zoning), distances from triggering property boundary to all existing and proposed structures, distances to surface improvements (parking, driveways), and location of existing structures on the triggering property to demonstrate compliance with height limits and buffer requirements.

applicableAreas: buildings within 75 feet of triggering property boundary
findings.comment: Compatibility cross-sections are not provided. Buildings 6 and 8 are within 75 feet of the triggering property boundary and are subject to height limit restrictions under § 25-2-1061 (structures less than 50 feet from triggering property are limited to 40 feet; 50–74 feet to 60 feet). Cross-sections must show the triggering property boundary, distance measurements at the 50-foot and 75-foot thresholds, proposed building heights at each distance band, and triggering property grade elevation to demonstrate compliance.
